part: Belden 1752A - Cat5e+ patch cable, 4 bonded pairs, 24 AWG stranded (7x32) tinned copper, U/UTP (CABLE-UMB reference cable)
notes: Belden's generated tech-data sheet (served gzip-encoded; saved decompressed), 3 pp. A STRANDED Cat5e PATCH cable, the construction CABLE-UMB's row asks for - NOT the lead that will be bought, whose gauge is open (26-28 AWG is common, 1.6-2.6x this DCR). Banked for the umbilical's line parameters in hardware/interfaces/spi-link/sim: input impedance 100 +/- 12 ohm at 1-20 MHz (the pair's differential impedance), nominal velocity of propagation 70 %, max delay 537.6 ns/100 m at 100 MHz, max conductor DCR 90 ohm/km, insertion loss 2.4 dB/100 m at 1 MHz. It gives no common-mode or cross-pair impedance: the sim sweeps that and says so. Belden 1700A/1583A (solid horizontal cable) fetched from the same catalogue and not banked.
